title: French Beans (Frasbean): modeled ₹1,486/qtl left, Kayamkulam → Aroor
summary: January 2025: reported french Beans (Frasbean) prices at Kayamkulam and Aroor imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 90% of 30 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹1,486 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 302 same-variety market pairs screened for french Beans (Frasbean) in January 2025; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Aroor report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2025
scenes.caption: Kayamkulam (Kerala) and Aroor (Kerala) both reported french Beans (Frasbean) prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 30 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kayamkulam reported a median ₹5,300 per quintal. Aroor reported a median ₹7,100 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,950/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,950 per quintal, and Aroor was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 91 km by road
scenes.caption: 91 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~1 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹20/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹1,345 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹1,033 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Aroor report, the rule selects 29 of 30 modeled shipping days. 27 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹1,486 per quintal (₹1,123 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled French Beans (Frasbean) route from Kayamkulam to Aroor was positive on 90% of matched days in January 2025. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹148,600, or ₹112,300 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to french Beans (Frasbean)
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹20/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled French Beans (Frasbean) route from Kayamkulam to Aroor was positive on 90% of matched days in January 2025. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹148,600, or ₹112,300 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,500 per quintal, and Aroor was dearer on 95% of days.

scenes.headline: 91 km by road
scenes.caption: 91 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~1 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹20/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹870 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹583 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Aroor report, the rule selects 18 of 22 modeled shipping days. 18 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹945 per quintal (₹649 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled French Beans (Frasbean) route from Kayamkulam to Aroor was positive on 82% of matched days in October 2025. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹94,500, or ₹64,900 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
